subject.title: [Bug]: Session transcript mirroring writes header cwd from process.cwd(), allowing cross-agent workspace contamination

question: Should maintainers rebase/adopt the existing linked PR or replace it with a fresh narrow fix for transcript header cwd isolation?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible and security-sensitive, but an open conflicting closing PR already owns the implementation path.

options.title: Adopt or rebase linked PR
options.body: Use the existing closing PR if it can be made current and reviewable without unrelated scope.

options.title: Replace with narrow fix
options.body: Create a fresh narrow implementation if the current branch is too stale or conflicted to salvage.

options.title: Defer to broad cwd cleanup
options.body: Keep this open for a larger process-cwd isolation effort, accepting that mirror headers can still record ambient cwd meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Adopt or rebase linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing closing PR if it can be made current and reviewable without unrelated scope.

likelyOwner.reason: Delivery mirror feature history and later session/outbound maintenance make this the strongest routing signal.
